title: Strict lower bound on the polychromatic parameter of dual axis-parallel strip hypergraphs
author: Balázs Bursics; Bence Csonka; Luca Szepessy
difficulty_reason: The counted object is the dual family A-star of axis-parallel strips (source lines 203-204): its vertices are the strips and its edges are the point-determined sets of strips that contain a point, so the obstruction is built in the primal plane and then read in the dual. The crux is the arrangement fixed at source line 479, where four strips are chosen so that each of their six pairs has a part of its intersection disjoint from the other two strips, which turns each pair of copy-families into a single edge of A-star of size 2(ceil(3k/4)-1). The closing step at source line 481 is not the usual one-family pigeonhole: a family has only ceil(3k/4)-1 vertices, hence at most that many colours and strictly more than k/4 missing colours, and only the sum over four such missing-colour sets forces two families to share an absent colour. Merely counting vertices of the arrangement, or quoting a Ramsey-type homogeneity statement, does not produce the factor 2(ceil(3k/4)-1)+1.
